props.text:
$ETH currently consolidating at 1,564-1,919 USDT range on 1D chart after strong Feb→Jul uptrend. Chart shows dual-timeframe binary inflection: breaks above ~1,200-1,400 resistance cluster → continue higher; rejection → retest support 1,000-1,200.

WR predicts resolution within 10 days. Notes concern about macro interference ("hopefully donald buying doesn't fk with my plan"), implying pre-existing conviction.

Aligns with WR's Jump Shark macro framework + barbell positioning (prior ETH put options Aug 05-06).
